name: draft_list
title: MTP drafts pick among 22.8 thousand frequent tokens of the project's code and docs (English and Russian) instead of 248 thousand (L4, L14)

needs.model_file: the served GGUF with a Q6_K output matrix

parity_check: Greedy text identical: a draft only proposes, the verify pass keeps the whole vocabulary.
notes: Read the draft acceptance ('drafts accepted') against the unchanged run: a draft outside the list is a lost draft. The Nsight Systems profile of 13 November put the output matrix (Q6_K, 2.46 ms a pass, three passes a step) at about 12.7% of the GPU time.
